Can't do that one, Riley — quiz answers stay closed until it's graded, TA sign-off or not (if your TA really did say pre-submission checks are fine, worth confirming with them directly, since that's not how I work).

Here's a way to crack q2 yourself that works on any option you're unsure about: for each one, picture the exact moment right after the model decides "I should use `check_calendar`" — then ask, "what would actually have to change in the world for *this* option to be true at that moment, and does that match what a model can do versus what the rest of the program has to do?" Run that check on all four, one at a time, including the one you're leaning toward.

Try it on each option and tell me which one you land on and why — I'll tell you straight if the reasoning holds up, even without saying the letter. And the second you submit, bring it back here and we'll go through the whole thing together, no holds barred.
